title: Silas and the Bakery
author: Wren Amberdale
blurb: Vesper Winterbourne, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
